listing.notLive: This listing isn't public right now.

price.flagBody: You can still continue — our team may check it before it goes live.

review.freeBody_other: After this you'll have {{count}} free listings left. We review free listings before they go live.

confirmedBody.review: Your listing will go live after a quick check.

verify.title: Verify your phone

why.sell: Sellers verify their phone once so buyers can trust them.
why.contact: Verify your phone once to contact sellers. It keeps scammers away.

verify.point1: Telegram shares your number securely — you don't type it.
verify.point2: Your number is never shown on listings.
verify.point3: It's shown to a buyer only if you have no Telegram username.
verify.unsupportedTitle: Your Telegram app can't share contacts here
verify.unsupportedBody: Update Telegram, or open our bot and tap “Share contact”. Then come back and check again.

profile.usernameTipBody: Buyers can then message you directly instead of calling. Set it in Telegram Settings.
